crossRefs.note: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days…
With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

translations.web: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
translations.bsb: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
translations.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
translations.asv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
